notes.title: 🛠 Patch Notes - Version 1.8
notes.notes:
🛠 Patch Notes - Version 1.8

New Features

Tutorial System Added

We've introduced in-game tutorials for both DM (Dungeon Master) Mode and Player Mode!

Bug Fixes
Token Deletion Bug

Fixed an issue where token deletion button would disappear

Token deletion is now more stable and reliable across different game states.

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.7
notes.notes:
Bug fixes on Character Creation
 NEW FEATURE: Now you can create enemy table tokens from premade tokens

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.5.0
notes.notes:
Encounter Generator For DM's has been added. Now you can instantly create an encounter and treasure for selected difficulty and environment.
 Event Log system has been added. Now campaign will track what has been done by players and DM and record them to the logs, which you can view in game.
 Bug fixes and QoL improvements on localization system
 Characters can now be viewed and created from menu without needing to create or join a room

notes.title: Patch Notes - 1.4.7
notes.notes:
NEW FEATURE: Save/Load Campaign Feature added. Now you can save the tokens and battlemap you've created and load it in any campaign you want.
 NEW FEATURE: Notification system added. Now DM will receive notifications on various systems when the system completes the target action.
 NEW QoL: Now you can click on images that are loaded to change the with another image
 Bug fixes on enemy token creation for DM
 Bug fixes on token dragging system
